title: START ... KEY IS ... — position the VSAM cursor for the next READ; no record returned directly
sourceContent:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. RANGE-SCAN.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  POLICY-FILE.
       01  POLICY-REC.
           05  POLICY-KEY  PIC X(10).
           05  POLICY-DATA PIC X(70).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-LO-KEY PIC X(10).
      *> START positions the cursor at the FIRST record where the key
      *> >= WS-LO-KEY. The next READ NEXT returns that record. START
      *> does NOT itself return data. Java rewrites usually combine
      *> position + read into a single getEntries(from, to) call.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN.
           START POLICY-FILE KEY IS NOT LESS THAN WS-LO-KEY
              INVALID KEY DISPLAY "no record at or after " WS-LO-KEY.
           READ POLICY-FILE NEXT.
notes: START + READ NEXT is the COBOL pattern for range scans on a keyed file. Java rewrites usually collapse this into a stream/iterator. The spec must surface the two-step (position then read) so the rewrite covers both.
